changeinfo.changes: - TRIAL MODE: Users on the Trial version of the game can now join campaign games hosted by users on the full version. Trial users can also now host online games on Chapter 1 and be joined by other Trial users. - New expanded Challenge mode! Now called 'Road To Stardom', this mode uses a new star-based progression and scoring system. - 10 new Challenges added to 'Road To Stardom' mode! - The Ball now visibly freezes when it is immobilized by touching Minsc's ice block. - Hosts can now transition their party directly to a different challenge level from the Pause Menu or Score screen without having to quit to the menus. - Various bug fixes in all areas of the game - Enabled V-Sync
